author: EmuCore - Hub
title: O PODER DO MEDIATEK! QUAL MELHOR EMULADOR DE PS2  AETHERSX2/ NETHRSX2/ EMUCOREX JOGANDO GOD OF WAR 2
summary: A controlled Poco X7 Pro comparison of EmuCoreX, NetherSX2 and AetherSX2 running the same God of War II section on a MediaTek/Mali platform.

blocks.text: TRC GAMES uses one Poco X7 Pro and repeats the same early God of War II route across three Android PS2 emulators. The presenter keeps the visible comparison near 2× resolution, displays frame-rate behavior and calls out drops instead of claiming a perfect result. That repeated scene makes renderer and emulator differences easier to see than unrelated clips from different games.

The presenter also acknowledges that the configuration is not exhaustive and invites better per-game settings. This caveat matters: the recording is a snapshot of the tested app builds, device firmware and Mali system driver, not a permanent ranking. Its value is the shared workload and honest pacing observations, especially when read alongside the exact settings shown on screen.
